news.title: Blue Jackets G Talbot sets NHL record with win on ninth team
news.ruTitle: Блю Джекетс Дж. Тэлбот установил рекорд НХЛ, одержав победу над девятой командой
news.description: Cam Talbot, a well-traveled 39-year-old goaltender, became the first NHL netminder to win a game with nine different franchises Friday night, when he stopped 20 shots in the Columbus Blue Jackets' 3-2 shootout victory over the Pittsburgh Penguins.

news.title: Judd Caulfield scores first NHL goal to help the Ducks beat the Jets 5-1
news.ruTitle: Джадд Колфилд забил первый гол в НХЛ и помог «Дакс» обыграть «Джетс» со счетом 5–1.
news.description: — Rookie Judd Caulfield scored his first NHL goal and added an assist to help the Anaheim Ducks beat Winnipeg 5-1 on Friday night for the Jets' first regulation loss of the season.

news.title: Blackhawks' Frank Nazar suspended 2 games for check to the head
news.ruTitle: Игрок «Блэкхокс» Фрэнк Назар дисквалифицирован на две игры за удар головой
news.description: Chicago Blackhawks forward Frank Nazar was suspended for two games without pay by the NHL on Friday night for an illegal check to the head of New York Islanders forward Bo Horvat on Thursday night.

news.title: Kent Johnson scores lone goal in shootout to give Blue Jackets 3-2 win over Penguins
news.ruTitle: Кент Джонсон забил единственный гол в серии пенальти и принес «Блю Джекетс» победу над «Пингвинз» со счетом 3:2.
news.description: — Kent Johnson scored the only goal in a shootout to lift the Columbus Blue Jackets over the Pittsburgh Penguins 3-2 on Friday night.

news.title: Capitals beat Rangers 3-1 after New York goalie Igor Shesterkin is helped off the ice with an injury

news.title: Gaudreau scores twice in 4-goal 2nd period as Kraken beat Red Wings 6-3
news.ruTitle: Годро забивает дважды во втором периоде с 4 голами, когда Кракен обыграл Ред Уингз со счетом 6-3
news.description: — Frederick Gaudreau scored twice, Ben Myers had a goal and two assists and the Seattle Kraken had a four-goal second period in a 6-3 victory over the Detroit Red Wings on Friday night.

news.title: Igor Shesterkin helped off ice after fall in Rangers' loss
news.ruTitle: Игорь Шестеркин помог оторваться от льда после падения в матче с «Рейнджерс»
news.description: New York Rangers goaltender Igor Shesterkin, the 30-year-old Russian who won the 2022 Vezina Trophy as the league's top netminder, had to be helped off the ice after an awkward fall into his own net in a 3-1 loss to the Washington Capitals on Friday.

news.title: Predators acquire Jayden Struble, 25, from Canadiens
news.description: The Nashville Predators bolstered their blue line on Friday night, adding defenseman Jayden Struble, 25, in a trade with the Montreal Canadiens, in exchange for a second-round draft pick in 2027.

news.title: Senators' Eklund out for 'extended' period with ankle injury
news.ruTitle: Эклунд из сенаторов выбыл на «длительный» период из-за травмы лодыжки
news.description: Senators forward William Eklund, who left Thursday's win over the Flyers after taking a hit, will miss an "extended" period of time with an ankle injury.

news.title: Defenseman Matt Dumba, 32, retires after 13 NHL seasons
news.ruTitle: Защитник Мэтт Дамба, 32 года, уходит в отставку после 13 сезонов в НХЛ
news.description: Matt Dumba, the 32-year-old defenseman who won the 2020 King Clancy Memorial Trophy, given to the player who best exemplified leadership qualities on and off the ice, is retiring after 13 NHL seasons with five different teams.

news.title: Panthers eyeing six-week timeline for Brad Marchand's return
news.ruTitle: «Пантеры» рассматривают шестинедельный график возвращения Брэда Маршана
news.description: The Panthers are expecting forward Brad Marchand to miss about six weeks with his left leg injury, a timeline that coincides with Aleksander Barkov being out six to eight weeks.

news.title: NHL breakout tiers: Top players ready to level up in 2026-27
news.ruTitle: Уровни прорыва в НХЛ: лучшие игроки готовы повысить свой уровень в сезоне 2026/27
news.description: From players with new linemates to young stars set to hit superstardom to enticing rookies, watch out for this group.
